title: Observation
description: One statistical value: a measured variable, about a place or other subject, for a date or period, with a value and the dataset it came from. This is schema.org `Observation`, used as is. `Observation` is a subtype of `QuantitativeValue`, so `value`, `unitText`, `minValue` and `maxValue` come with it.

observationAbout.description: WHERE or WHO this describes: a `Jurisdiction`, a statistical area (`Place`), or any other entity schemaGov represents. Always a reference, never a copy.

variableMeasured.description: WHAT was measured: a `StatisticalVariable`. The population subset (age 65+, female) lives in the variable, so there is no per-subset property on the observation.

value.description: The value. A count, a rate or a median, in the unit the variable and `unitText` state. A suppressed or missing value is not an observation: omit it.

unitCode.description: The unit as a UN/CEFACT code, where one exists.

observationDate.description: WHEN, for a point in time or a single calendar period: `2024`, `2024-06`, `2024-06-30`. Use this OR `observationPeriod`, never both.

observationPeriod.description: WHEN, for an estimate pooled over a span: an ISO 8601 interval, `2020/2024`. A five-year estimate is a period, not a point on its last day.

marginOfError.description: Optional. Present only when the source publishes one. A `QuantitativeValue` in the same unit as `value`.

additionalProperty.description: Carries the confidence level, as a `PropertyValue` with `propertyID` `confidenceLevel` and a value between 0 and 1 (0.9 is 90%).

minValue.description: Optional lower bound of the stated interval.

maxValue.description: Optional upper bound of the stated interval.

measurementMethod.description: Optional. How it was obtained: `survey estimate`, `administrative count`, `census`.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` that produced this value. Publisher, version and release date are read from the dataset, never copied here.
